metrics.decode_tok_s_median: per-request steady decode after first token
metrics.aggregate_decode_window_tok_s: all post-first tokens divided by shared decode window
metrics.aggregate_active_decode_rate_sum: sum of per-request steady decode rates

notes: No run uses eager mode; compile and CUDA graphs stay enabled.
vLLM uses TRITON_ATTN for BF16 KV and FLASHINFER for FP8 KV; SGLang uses its default FlashInfer attention backend.
Fast profile measures the full concurrency knee at 8K and single-stream decay at every deeper context.
Every completed point is fsync'd and atomically renamed for reboot-safe resume.
